headline: Food safety and order-handling issues were the main risks this week, with Peelamedu driving most of the negative feedback.

top_complaints.title: Stale and contaminated dishes
top_complaints.insight: Customers most often complained about stale mutton, spoiled curry or kuzhambu, and hair found in food, with several serious safety reports tied to specific outlets.

top_complaints.title: Wrong and missing orders
top_complaints.insight: Delivery complaints focused on orders marked delivered but not received, wrong items sent, and late food, with Swiggy standing out as the main platform.

top_complaints.title: Payment failures at checkout
top_complaints.insight: Customers reported failed payments that were still debited, plus checkout and support problems, with Peelamedu appearing most often in these app complaints.

top_praise.title: Homely, tasty dishes
top_praise.insight: Customers praised the kothu parotta, lunch meals, nattu kozhi curry, and Chettinad chicken biryani for strong flavour and a homely taste.

top_praise.title: Fast hot deliveries
top_praise.insight: Customers praised quick delivery, including orders arriving hot and on time even in the rain.

top_praise.title: Polite helpful service
top_praise.insight: Customers praised friendly, quick, and helpful service, with RS Puram mentioned most often in the positive staff feedback.

urgent_clusters.title: Hair found in food at Gandhipuram
urgent_clusters.why_it_matters: This is a repeated food-safety issue that can quickly damage trust and create serious reputational risk.

urgent_clusters.title: Stale mutton biryani at RS Puram
urgent_clusters.why_it_matters: Repeated reports about spoiled meat suggest a serious kitchen-quality control problem that needs immediate attention.

urgent_clusters.title: Fish fry illness at Peelamedu
urgent_clusters.why_it_matters: Several nearby reports describe illness after the same dish, which is the most serious risk and needs urgent investigation.

urgent_clusters.title: Payment debited but order failed
urgent_clusters.why_it_matters: Customers who lose money at checkout are likely to escalate, request refunds, and avoid ordering again.

urgent_clusters.title: Marked delivered but not received
urgent_clusters.why_it_matters: Repeated missing-order cases create refund pressure and make the delivery process look unreliable.

action_items: Inspect food handling and prep checks at Gandhipuram, RS Puram, and Peelamedu before the next service and remove any dish linked to hair, spoilage, or illness.
Audit fish fry prep and storage at Peelamedu immediately, then stop serving that item until the issue is traced and corrected.
Work with Swiggy and the in-house team to fix failed payments and marked-delivered orders, and close each refund case the same day.
